units.rawText: ...So you're here at last?
units.displayText: ...So you're here at last?

units.displayText: Like before, he remains shrouded by that thick purple fog as he directs his mocking laughter at me.

spans.text: Like before, he remains shrouded by that thick purple fog as he directs his mocking laughter at me.

units.rawText: The anger and hatred from the previous world line is still burning in my chest. That's right, he must be the one behind all this. I will never forgive him for what he's done.

units.displayText: Who... is Mayuri?

spans.text: Once again, he asks a question. And then, he seems to have remembered something, because he answers his own question.

units.rawText: Ah—I remember now.
units.displayText: Ah—I remember now.

spans.text: Ah—I remember now.

units.displayText: Is she the girl with the long hair? Or the one in the blue dress?

spans.text: Is she the girl with the long hair? Or the one in the blue dress?

units.rawText: They're both rarities... and because they're rare, that makes them valuable.

spans.text: They're both rarities... and because they're rare, that makes them valuable.

spans.text: "Run away", "run away", "run away."
